comparator.name: Slavonic Language and Culture (Slavische talen en culturen)
comparator.sourceNotes: The retained Russian main-language route closes 60+60+60. Its required 30-EC abroad semester follows the current 54-EC first-year and 18-EC second-year gate, including Russian 5 and 6; optional internships stay within the genuine 30-EC free profile. The research lab and 12-EC thesis remain distinct. Diagnostic and tutoring formation are zero-credit. Current evidence supports Dutch and Russian instruction; current route order does not invalidate the already selected coherent Russian route.
